name: Siranchowk Khaja Ghar
description: Official web application for Siranchowk Khaja Ghar (सिरानचोक खाजा घर), a 100% Halal Nepali eatery in Khairahani-6, Parsa, Chitwan — featuring a responsive menu and ordering system, customer accounts, order tracking, an interactive Google Maps locator, and a secure operations dashboard.
